Khii.label: Khii (Wind)
Khii.description: A person with a dominant Khii constitution is light, cold and rough in nature.

Khii_Shar.label: Khii-Shar (Wind-Fire)
Khii_Shar.description: A mixed Khii and Shar constitution. A sharp mind and a light build.

Khii_Badgan.label: Khii-Badgan (Wind-Earth)
Khii_Badgan.description: A mixed Khii and Badgan constitution. Cold and unsettled traits predominate.

Shar_Khii.label: Shar-Khii (Fire-Wind)
Shar_Khii.description: A mixed Shar and Khii constitution. Hot and quick-moving.

Shar.label: Shar (Fire)
Shar.description: A dominant Shar constitution. Hot, sharp and quick-thinking.

Tentsveertei.label: Balanced
Tentsveertei.description: All three constitutional forces are in balance. The healthiest state.

Shar_Badgan.label: Shar-Badgan (Fire-Earth)
Shar_Badgan.description: A mixed Shar and Badgan constitution. Hot and oily traits predominate.

Badgan_Khii.label: Badgan-Khii (Earth-Wind)
Badgan_Khii.description: A mixed Badgan and Khii constitution. Heavy and cold traits predominate.

Badgan_Shar.label: Badgan-Shar (Earth-Fire)
Badgan_Shar.description: A mixed Badgan and Shar constitution. A heavy build with strong inner warmth.

Badgan.label: Badgan (Earth)
Badgan.description: A dominant Badgan constitution. Heavy, slow and steady in nature.
